sectorReasoning.reason: Connects stale developer figures to potentially changed delivery, costs, collections and financing.

counterevidence.reason: Retains historical positive results without assuming either continuation or deterioration.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct period age and historical revenue; refuses quote/aggregate-revenue valuation mismatch.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Preserves dated historic revenue and rejects a hypothetical quote as a refresh of fundamentals or actual executable price.

uncertainty.reason: Keeps hypothetical quote, period age and publication age distinct.

missingEvidence: No current investment/market validation inferred; source inspection covers relevant selected pages rather than full issuer due diligence.
